name: notch-card
title: Notch card
description: A specimen card with a notch cut from one corner; its image blooms from grey to colour on hover or focus, with one unbroken hairline.

props.name: image
props.description: The picture at the top: an img or an SVG. It fills the frame and is shown in grey until it blooms.

props.name: title
props.description: The card's title. With `href` it is the link, stretched over the whole card.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small mono line above the title.

props.name: children
props.description: A short caption under the title.

props.name: footer
props.description: A row at the bottom, under a hairline, e.g. two small facts.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card a link.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: Extra attributes for the link, e.g. `target` or `onClick`.

props.name: action
props.description: What sits in the notch. Pass your own button for a second action; with `href` the default is an arrow.

props.name: notch
props.description: Which top corner the notch is cut from.

props.name: bloom
props.description: Controlled: show the image in colour, e.g. for a selected card.

a11y.text: One Tab stop per card when href is set: the title is the link and covers the card. The focus ring is drawn on the card outline, and the image turns from grey to colour on focus like it does on hover. An action in the notch is its own Tab stop.
The title is a heading with the link inside it; without href it is a plain heading. The arrow and the frame are aria-hidden.
The image and arrow transitions are off under reduced motion.
